suggested_issue_title: README "Create a Chart" example assigns Chart.Name, which is read-only (CS0200)
suggested_issue_body:
repository-presenter's validation pipeline (BC-03) recorded this while re-verifying `aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-.NET`; it was then reproduced independently against the live default-branch head `941814fd138dc28cf47123d48194f329f283498d` on 2026-10-09T21:15Z.

## Summary

`src/Aspose.Cells_FOSS/Chart.cs:47` declares `public string Name => _model.Name;` (get-only). The README chart example assigns to it.

## Environment

- Revision `941814fd138dc28cf47123d48194f329f283498d` (default branch `master`)
- .NET SDK 10.0.401, net10.0 console project referencing `src/Aspose.Cells_FOSS/Aspose.Cells_FOSS.csproj` (library builds with 0 warnings); `using Aspose.Cells_FOSS;` added as the README states

## Steps to reproduce

`Program.cs` = `using Aspose.Cells_FOSS;` plus README.md lines 242-256 verbatim, then `dotnet build`.

## Actual result

```
Program.cs(15,1): error CS0200: Property or indexer 'Chart.Name' cannot be assigned to -- it is read only
```

## Where in the repository

- `README.md:254` (`chart.Name = "Revenue";`)
- `src/Aspose.Cells_FOSS/Chart.cs:47`
- The repository's own sample `samples/Aspose.Cells_FOSS.Samples.Charts/Program.cs:30,34` only reads `Name`

## Evidence

- `README.md`: lines 240-257, failing statement at line 254 (revision 941814fd138dc28cf47123d48194f329f283498d; unchanged at the live head)
- `dotnet build of a console project containing README.md:242-256 verbatim`: 2026-10-09T21:15Z: error CS0200: Property or indexer 'Chart.Name' cannot be assigned to -- it is read only
- `src/Aspose.Cells_FOSS/Chart.cs`: line 47: public string Name => _model.Name;
